scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions. Generate a random string with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: The Worker's public URL: `https://<worker name>.<your subdomain>.workers.dev`, using the Worker name chosen on this page, or your custom domain.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender for invites, notifications and password resets, e.g. `spool@yourdomain.com`. Must be on a domain enabled for **Cloudflare Email Sending**, or verified with Resend if you add a `RESEND_API_KEY` secret later.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email Sending. To use [Resend](https://resend.com) instead, add a `RESEND_API_KEY` secret after deploying.

DB.description: Holds members, requests and comments. Migrations run on every deploy.
